5. Identify the incorrect formulae among the following.
(A) $\mathrm{Mg}_2\mathrm{N}_3$ (B) $\mathrm{Al}_2(\mathrm{SO}_4)_3$
(C) $\mathrm{Ca}_2(\mathrm{PO}_4)_3$ (D) $\mathrm{NH}_4\mathrm{HCO}_3$
(E) $\mathrm{NaH}_2\mathrm{PO}_4$
(A) DE (b) AC (c) AE

6. A gas was transferred from one-litre cylinder into another cylinder of differ-
ent volume at the same temperature. Then, the pressure exerted by the gas
increased by 20%. Identify the volume of the new cylinder.
(a) 480 mL (b) 1170 mL
(c) 833 mL (d) 607 mL

7. Arrange the following conditions of pressure and temperature in the increas-
ing order of volumes occupied by one mole of a gas.
(A) 600 mm and 200 K (B) 400 mm and 100 K
(C) 600 mm and 100 K (D) 400 mm and 200 K
(a) CBAD (b) BCAD (c) CADB (d) BACD

8. The following pie chart represents the percentage composition by weight of
calcium bicarbonate. Identify the components 'A', 'B', 'C' and 'D' indicated
in the pie chart.

The image displays a simple black-and-white line drawing of a circle divided into four distinct sectors, resembling a pie chart. There are no X or Y axes, numerical values, or a legend present. The sectors are labeled with capital letters: Sector A is the largest, occupying the majority of the circle's area (visually estimated to be approximately 75%). Sector B is the second largest, located in the upper-right quadrant (visually estimated at ~12.5%). Sector C is the third largest, located in the lower-right quadrant (visually estimated at ~12.5%). Sector D is the smallest, located in the upper-left quadrant (visually estimated at ~3.1%). The sum of the labeled percentages is 92.5%, indicating that the remaining 7.5% is unlabeled.

(a) A $\rightarrow$ Ca; B $\rightarrow$ O; C $\rightarrow$ C; D $\rightarrow$ H
(b) A $\rightarrow$ O; B $\rightarrow$ Ca; C $\rightarrow$ C; D $\rightarrow$ H
(c) A $\rightarrow$ Ca; B $\rightarrow$ C; C $\rightarrow$ H; D $\rightarrow$ O
(d) A $\rightarrow$ O; B $\rightarrow$ C; C $\rightarrow$ Ca; D $\rightarrow$ H

9. $x$ grams of a diatomic gas occupies 5.6 L volume at STP. Identify the incor-
rect statement regarding the gas.
(a) The sample of gas contains $1.5 \times 10^{23}$ molecules.
(b) The total number of atoms will be $3 \times 10^{23}$.
(c) If the gas is oxygen, then $x$ is equal to 8 g.
(d) The vapour density of the gas would be $4x$.

10. The empirical formula mass of a compound is one-sixth of its molecular
mass. What is the molecular formula corresponding to that substance?
(a) $\mathrm{C}_{12}\mathrm{H}_{22}\mathrm{O}_{11}$ (b) $\mathrm{C}_6\mathrm{H}_{12}\mathrm{O}_6$
(c) $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_4\mathrm{O}_3$ (d) $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_6\mathrm{O}_2$
